design: A simple flat emblem in the style of a crude stencil or woodcut, solid flat shapes with hard edges, no shading, no texture, no detail, filling the whole picture edge to edge on a plain solid red background: a white arm holding a sword and a yellow skull over crossed bones. The flag is a worn red wool bunting "bloody flag" about 3 by 2, its figures crudely painted on it in flat white paint, as a pirate crew made one aboard ship in 1700: simple bold flat shapes of one colour, unshaded, no detail, no picture, sun-faded and powder-stained, frayed at the fly.
